en: Sepia-toned photograph showing a walled historic town with a prominent church tower and very tall, slender spire at the center. The spire is topped with scaffolding or an ornate structure. In the foreground is a garden or park path framed by bushes. To the left is a round medieval tower integrated into the town wall; additional stone buildings with tiled roofs stand behind the wall. The overall look is early 20th‑century European.
